annotations.text:
1. Conversation
Real chat transcript, open-ended opener. One free-text message satisfies several requirements at once; assistant recaps inline and asks the next missing thing in-line — two full question cycles shown, no button between them.

2. What I know so far
A bottom sheet OVER the chat (never a separate page — note the dimmed chat sliver behind it). Known items only, flowing chips, no required/optional badges, no missing-field rows, no continue button. Optional items are a muted secondary cluster, not a form field.

3. Search loading (M7→M8→M9)
Discover → enrich → rank, shown as sequential steps.

4. Recommendations
Swipe deck, one provider at a time. FACT + INFERRED only — no SIMULATED yet (D14).

5. Provider details + selection
Full FACT list, evidence-backed INFERRED tags, per-dimension score bars (dashed = no data, D13h).

6. M10 loading
Deterministic gap analysis + question prep — still no simulated content.

7. M10 questions + M11 simulated answers
Dashed amber cards, persistent disclosure banner: no real contact happened.

8. Error state
Upstream LLM / research failure (502) — honest tone, answers preserved, retry.
